correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the forbidden-matching inequality x+y<=s-2 and exact union K=(A*Delta2) union (C*D) union (Delta1*B) with A=NM_(a-1)(C_n), C=NM_a(C_n), B=NM_(b-1)(C_m), D=NM_b(C_m). Single-cycle cyclic-polytope theorem gives A,B spheres dimensions 2a-5,2b-5 and C,D dimensions 2a-3,2b-3; all length>=6 keep them positive-dimensional and A->C/B->D are null by connectivity. Mayer–Vietoris for P,R and Q gives H_(2s-8)(R)->H_(2s-8)(P) an isomorphism by naturality on A*B, not zero. The long exact sequence then leaves Z² in degree 2s-6 and Z in 2s-5, with no torsion. Independently enumerated full GF2 simplicial boundaries for (6,6),(6,7),(7,7) and recovered the specified Betti ranks in their only positive degrees. Infinite integral result rests on Mayer–Vietoris, not finite sampling.
residual_risks: Only reduced integral homology is proved, not a homotopy/wedge type; n,m>=6 threshold exactly s-1.
The finite mod-two tests do not establish integral torsion absence; the analytic integral exact sequence does.
